theorems.name: Submission.frt_weq_density_borel_representative
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) [SFinite μ], ∃ g : Euclidean N → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g ∧ ∀ (x : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ≥0∞), HasDensity n μ x t → g x = t
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
